defs.def: a sudden, violent shaking of the earth's surface 地震

ex.s: It is also said that mice and snakes head for safer ground several days before an earthquake, while dogs avoiding the beach may be a sign that a tsunami is approaching.
ex.t: 也有人说，老鼠和蛇会在地震前几天逃往更安全的地方，而狗避开海滩可能是海啸即将来临的征兆。

ex.s: (Picture) The 8.1-magnitude Earthquake that hit Nepal on 25 April 2015, was one of the worst earthquakes in history.
ex.t: （图）2015年4月25日袭击尼泊尔的8.1级地震是历史上最严重的地震之一。

ex.s: Consisting of 62 people, it not only included rescuers and medical staff, but also included earthquake experts.
ex.t: 由62人组成，不仅包括救援人员和医务人员，还包括地震专家。

ex.s: (Picture 1) drought (Picture 2) typhoon (Picture 3) blizzard (Picture 4) tsunami (Picture 5) wildfire (Picture 6) avalanche (Picture 7) earthquake 1.Which one do you think is the most dangerous?
ex.t: （图1）干旱 （图2）台风 （图3）暴风雪 （图4）海啸 （图5）野火 （图6）雪崩 （图7）地震 1.你认为哪一个最危险？

ex.s: Such another destruction of ornaments and bottles as the earthquake created, San Francisco never saw before.
ex.t: 像地震造成的这种装饰品和瓶子的毁灭，旧金山以前从未见过。
